title: revert: remove Mistral OCR 4
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Reverts #12776 (commit `d2d1ca05b`). Reverting is the maintainer's call — no technical fault is being asserted here.

- Clean `git revert`, no conflicts. Every one of the 26 files the original commit touched is now byte-identical to its pre-OCR state.
- Removes `gen.pollinations.ai/src/text/mistralOcr.ts`, `shared/registry/mistral-ocr-billing.ts`, `gen.pollinations.ai/test/ocr.test.ts`, the `mistral-ocr` registry/model-info/schema entries, the SDK OCR client + types, and the enter frontend catalog/badge changes.
- Tests: gen suite 79 files / 759 tests before → 78 files / 746 after (-1 file, -13 tests, exactly `ocr.test.ts`). All pass. `tsc --noEmit` clean for gen and enter; `biome check` clean.
- No encrypted secrets file was touched by #12776 or by this revert. `MISTRAL_API_KEY` was already in `REQUIRED_SECRET_KEYS` before #12776; that commit added a redundant duplicate to `OPTIONAL_SECRET_KEYS`, and only the duplicate is removed here. Secret deployment behaviour is unchanged.
- Grep for `mistral-ocr` / `mistralOcr` across the tree returns zero hits. Remaining `mistral` references are the pre-existing Mistral Small 3.2 / Small 4 / large text models.

Do not merge without maintainer sign-off.

gist.headline: OCR leaves the garden
gist.blurb: The Mistral OCR branch has been neatly pruned back to the pre-OCR state. Polli checked the roots: no stray registry entries, SDK types, catalog badges, or secret changes remain.
gist.summary: Reverted the Mistral OCR 4 integration, removing its gen API handler, model registry and billing entries, SDK OCR client and types, frontend catalog listing, and 13 OCR-specific tests.
gist.impact: The API, SDK, and model catalog now return to their pre-Mistral-OCR configuration, while existing Mistral Small 3.2, Small 4, and Large text-model support remains available.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a careful garden cleanup: Polli, wearing a tiny gardener hat, removes a labeled OCR code-plant from a cozy model garden while a retro terminal shows the remaining Mistral text-model plants thriving. The scene represents a clean, complete revert rather than a broken system, with discarded OCR pages composting into pixel soil.
